items.name: Por Pia Tod (Golden Crispy Rolls)
items.thaiName: เปาะเปี๊ยะทอด
items.description: Crispy hand-rolled pastries stuffed with glass noodles, shredded taro, shiitake mushrooms, and sweet cabbage. Served with homemade sweet organic plum-chili sauce.

items.name: Chicken Satay Skewers
items.thaiName: สะเต๊ะไก่
items.description: Tender chicken tenderloins steeped in turmeric, lemongrass, and coconut marinade, flame-grilled on bamboo skewers. Paired with warm rich peanut sauce and pickled cucumber relish.

items.name: Thung Thong (Golden Money Bags)
items.thaiName: ถุงทอง
items.description: Delicate crispy wonton purses tied with green chives, packed with minced prawns, sweet water chestnuts, and fragrant cilantro root. Symbol of prosperity and joyful dining.

items.name: Tod Mun Pla (Thai Fish Cakes)
items.thaiName: ทอดมันปลา
items.description: Wild-caught white fish pounded with red curry paste, kaffir lime ribbons, and long green beans, lightly flash-fried. Served with sweet cucumber chili relish and toasted crushed peanuts.

items.name: Tom Yum Goong Mae Nam
items.thaiName: ต้มยำกุ้งแม่น้ำ
items.description: Thailand's iconic aromatic lemongrass broth simmered with colossal wild river prawns, galangal, kaffir lime leaf, straw mushrooms, and roasted chili oil with a splash of evaporated milk.

items.name: Tom Kha Gai (Coconut Galangal Soup)
items.thaiName: ต้มข่าไก่
items.description: Silky, comforting broth of slow-simmered rich coconut cream, sliced free-range chicken, young galangal root, fresh lime juice, and oyster mushrooms garnished with cilantro.

items.name: Som Tum Thai (Artisan Papaya Salad)
items.thaiName: ส้มตำไทย
items.description: Crisp hand-shredded green papaya, snake beans, and sweet heirloom cherry tomatoes bruised in a stone mortar with bird's eye chilies, palm sugar, tamarind lime dressing, and roasted peanuts.

items.name: Larb Gai Isan (Spiced Herb Chicken Salad)
items.thaiName: ลาบไก่
items.description: Warm minced organic chicken tossed with toasted jasmine rice powder (khao khua), fresh mint leaves, shallots, scallions, fresh lime juice, and fiery Isan dried chili flakes.

items.name: Royal Massaman Lamb Shank
items.thaiName: มัสมั่นแกะ
items.description: Fall-off-the-bone 6-hour braised lamb shank in an opulent royal Massaman curry infused with cardamom, cinnamon, star anise, baby Dutch yellow potatoes, shallots, and toasted whole peanuts.

items.name: Gaeng Keow Wan (Emerald Green Curry)
items.thaiName: แกงเขียวหวานไก่
items.description: Fragrant green curry crafted from freshly pounded green bird's eye chilies, Thai round eggplants, crisp bamboo shoots, tender chicken breast, sweet Thai basil, and coconut cream.

items.name: Panang Curry with Prime Beef
items.thaiName: พะแนงเนื้อ
items.description: Thick, rich, and velvety red curry reduction infused with roasted cumin, finely slivered makrut lime leaves, sliced prime flank steak, and crushed peanuts finished with coconut swirl.

items.name: Pineapple Roast Duck Curry (Gaeng Phed Ped Yang)
items.thaiName: แกงเผ็ดเป็ดย่าง
items.description: Succulent crispy-skin roasted duck simmered in fragrant red curry with sweet caramelized Phuket pineapple chunks, heirloom cherry tomatoes, lychee, and fresh holy basil.

items.name: Pad Thai Boran (Royal Bangkok Style)
items.thaiName: ผัดไทยโบราณ
items.description: Chanthaburi rice noodles flash-fried in smoky woks with jumbo black tiger prawns, pressed pressed spiced tofu, sweet preserved radish, garlic chives, crunchy bean sprouts, and tamarind palm-sugar glaze.

items.name: Pad See Ew (Charred River Noodles)
items.thaiName: ผัดซีอิ๊ว
items.description: Wide flat rice noodles wok-seared over high flame for deep smoky 'wok hei' aroma, tossed with tender sliced flank steak, crisp Chinese broccoli (Gai Lan), organic egg, and aged dark sweet soy sauce.

items.name: Pad Kee Mao (Drunken Seafood Noodles)
items.thaiName: ผัดขี้เมาทะเล
items.description: Fiery wok-tossed wide noodles with jumbo sea prawns, tender calamari, fresh green peppercorn clusters, fragrant holy basil leaves, baby corn, and crushed bird's eye chilies.

items.name: Khao Pad Poo (Royal Lump Crab Fried Rice)
items.thaiName: ข้าวผัดปู
items.description: Fluffy fragrant jasmine rice stir-fried in a roaring hot wok with generous heaps of sweet Dungeness lump crab meat, organic farm eggs, green scallions, white pepper, and side Prik Nam Pla (chili fish sauce).

items.name: Pla Rad Prik (Crispy Whole Seabass)
items.thaiName: ปลากะพงราดพริก
items.description: Crispy whole wild Mediterranean seabass drizzled in our house three-flavor caramelized sauce of tart tamarind, palm nectar, garlic, and sweet red chili reduction, crowned with flash-fried holy basil leaves.

items.name: Suea Rong Hai (Crying Tiger Prime Ribeye)
items.thaiName: เสือร้องไห้
items.description: 12oz USDA Prime ribeye marinated in crushed garlic, cilantro roots, and Thai spices, char-grilled to medium rare perfection. Accompanied by spicy toasted rice Nam Jim Jaew dipping sauce.

items.name: Hor Mok Talay (Royal Seafood Soufflé)
items.thaiName: ห่อหมกทะเล
items.description: Aromatic mousse of wild prawns, sea scallops, and flaky fish steamed gently inside a young green coconut with red curry paste, egg, sweet basil, and thick coconut custard.

items.name: Khao Niew Mamuang (Mango Sticky Rice)
items.thaiName: ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วง
items.description: Sweet slices of golden Thai honey mango resting on warm steamed sticky rice infused with salted sweet coconut milk, sprinkled with toasted crunchy yellow mung beans.

items.name: Thai Tea Crème Brûlée
items.thaiName: แครมบรูเล่ชาไทย
items.description: Silky custard infused with authentic Cha Tra Mue black tea leaves, star anise, and sweetened condensed milk beneath a golden, crackling caramelized sugar crust.

items.name: I-Tim Kati (Young Coconut Ice Cream)
items.thaiName: ไอติมกะทิสด
items.description: House-churned dairy-free coconut milk gelato served inside a tender young coconut half shell with roasted peanuts, sweet corn kernels, and sticky palm jelly.

items.name: Traditional Thai Iced Tea (Cha Yen)
items.thaiName: ชาเย็น
items.description: Slow-brewed dark Thai red tea spiced with star anise and crushed cardamom pods, poured over crushed ice and topped with a luscious layer of sweet half-and-half.

items.name: Siam Orchid Passion (Craft Cocktail)
items.thaiName: สยามออร์คิด
items.description: Artisan botanical gin shaken with house-made lemongrass syrup, sweet lychee liqueur, fresh passionfruit puree, butterfly pea infusion, and a splash of sparkling prosecco.

items.name: Butterfly Pea Flower Herbal Cooler
items.thaiName: น้ำอัญชันมะนาว
items.description: Naturally vibrant blue butterfly pea flower tea with organic wild honey and fresh squeezed lime juice that magically shifts the color from deep sapphire to royal violet before your eyes.
